pl.comment: at some point, this file should become empty and unnecessary.

event_deaths.one: This past moon, m_c has taken {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} place in StarClan. c_n mourns the loss of their Clanmate, and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates will miss where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had been in their lives. Moments of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} final resting place.
event_deaths.many: The past moon, %{insert} have taken their place in StarClan. c_n mourns their loss, and their Clanmates will miss where they had been in their lives. Moments of their lives are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to them take them to their final resting place.

event_shaken_grief.one: So much grief and death has taken its toll on the cats of c_n. %{insert} is particularly shaken by it.
event_shaken_grief.many: So much grief and death has taken its toll on the cats of c_n. %{insert} are particularly shaken by it.

pl.condition_retire_adolescent: %{name} decides {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'d rather spend {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} time helping around camp and entertaining the kits; {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} warmly welcomed into the elders' den.
pl.condition_retire_adolescent_ceremony: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} given the name %{newname} in honor of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} contributions to %{clan}.
pl.condition_retire_no_leader: m_c has decided to retire from normal Clan duty.
pl.condition_retire_normal: Seeing m_c struggling the last few moons, lead_name approaches {PRONOUN/m_c/object} and promises that no one would think less of {PRONOUN/m_c/object} for retiring early, and that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} would still be a valuable member of the Clan as an elder. m_c agrees; later that day, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} elder ceremony is held.
pl.ceremony_closer: Visit lead_name's profile to see {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} full leader ceremony.
pl.ceremony_deputy_none: There are no cats fit to become deputy.

adoption_kittens_single.one: %{names} found a %{insert} and decides to adopt it.
adoption_kittens_single.many: %{names} found a %{insert} and decides to adopt them.

adoption_kittens_pair.one: %{names} found a %{insert} and decide to adopt it.
adoption_kittens_pair.many: %{names} found a %{insert} and decide to adopt them.

herbs_found.zero: med_name could not find any herbs this moon.

prey_catch_count.one: The Clan managed to catch %{count} piece of prey this moon.
prey_catch_count.many: The Clan managed to catch %{count} pieces of prey this moon.

focus_prey.zero: Despite the focus of the Clan, no additional prey could be gathered.
focus_prey.one: With the heightened focus of the Clan, %{count} additional piece of prey was gathered.
focus_prey.many: With the heightened focus of the Clan, %{count} additional pieces of prey were gathered.

focus_herbs.zero: Despite the focus of the Clan, no additional herbs could be gathered.
focus_herbs.one: With the focus of the Clan, %{herbs} was gathered.
focus_herbs.many: With the focus of the Clan, %{herbs} were gathered.

focus_raid_prey.one: With the focus of the Clan, %{count} piece of prey was... acquired.
focus_raid_prey.many: With the focus of the Clan, %{count} pieces of prey were... acquired.

focus_injury_hoarding.zero: Luckily, nobody in the Clan got %{condition} due to hoarding.
focus_injury_hoarding.one: A cat got %{condition} due to hoarding herbs and prey.
focus_injury_hoarding.many: Multiple cats got %{condition} due to hoarding herbs and prey.

focus_injury_raiding.zero: Luckily, nobody in the Clan got %{condition} during raids.
focus_injury_raiding.one: A cat got %{condition} while raiding other Clans for more prey.
focus_injury_raiding.many: Multiple cats got %{condition} while raiding other Clans for more prey.

pl.event_lost1: After a long journey, m_c has finally returned home to c_n.
pl.event_lost2: m_c was found at the border, tired but happy to be home.
pl.event_lost3: m_c strides into camp, much to the everyone's surprise. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} home!
pl.event_lost4: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} met so many friends on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} journey, but c_n is where m_c truly belongs. With a tearful goodbye, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/return/returns} home.
pl.event_returning_child_of_lost: m_c approaches the Clan and asks to join, claiming to be %{parent_name}'s kitten.

kittencough_spread.one: Kittencough has spread around the nursery. %{kits} is affected.
kittencough_spread.many: Kittencough has spread around the nursery. %{kits} are affected.

flea_spread.one: Fleas have been hopping from pelt to pelt and now %{cats} is infested.
flea_spread.two: Fleas have been hopping from pelt to pelt and now %{cats} are both infested.
flea_spread.many: Fleas have been hopping from pelt to pelt and now %{cats} are all infested.

pl.illness_spread: %{illness} has spread around the camp. %{cats} have been infected.
pl.scar_event0: m_c's %{injury} has healed, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'ll always carry evidence of it on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pelt.
pl.scar_event1: m_c healed from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} %{injury} but will forever be marked by a scar.
pl.scar_event2: m_c's %{injury} has healed, but the injury left {PRONOUN/m_c/object} scarred.
pl.move_on_dead_mate: m_c will always love r_c, but has decided to move on.

expired_prey.one: A piece of freshkill expired and was removed from the freshkill pile.
expired_prey.many: %{count} pieces of prey expired and were removed from the freshkill pile.

consumed_prey.one: One piece of prey was consumed.
